task: Measure W2 caller-worklist inference on the W5 wide-inference workload.
observation: Three alternating same-runner -O2 check pairs for w5_infer_wide_w100.moss had median times of 10.9169 s on the W1 compiler and 0.3834 s on W2 (96.5% lower); all check JSON outputs matched. The W2 profile retained inference_rounds=5 and reported 1,200 function visits over six worklist waves.
impact: The worklist reduces repeated function inference substantially on its target workload while preserving the observable check result; the focused measurement still requires hosted same-runner confirmation and does not represent the full B1 suite.

resolution.summary: Local same-runner evidence passes. Hosted PR #18 performance and regression gates and final exact-SHA review are pending.
